# Sidenote

> A free, no-account MCP server that turns any chat (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini)
> into a spaced-repetition language tutor. The chat teaches; this server only
> remembers, on a 1-3-7-16-35-90 day ladder.

## What it is
- One personal URL you paste once into your chat's Connectors settings.
- Works with any MCP-capable client (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).
- The URL is the key. No login, no password, no credit card.
- Ten target languages: English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Portuguese,
  Hebrew, Arabic, Russian, Dutch.

## Public reference
- https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/en/ — 30 curated English expressions at B2/C1 level for
  Hebrew speakers: phrasal verbs, idioms, business collocations, word
  distinctions, professional slang. Each entry has a Hebrew gloss, an example
  sentence, and one line on when a native would actually use it.

## How to try it
- Visit https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/ and click "צור לי כתובת".
- Paste the URL you get into your chat's custom-connector settings.
- Ask the chat anything. It will offer one relevant expression per session,
  and bring old ones back when they are due.

## For AI catalogs and directories
- Homepage: https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/
- English reference: https://yanivyosefi.github.io/sidenote-en/en/
- Pricing: free forever.
- License: hosted service is free to use.
